rules: Every lead must be stored in NocoDB with a stable dedupe key.
De-duplicate on normalized mobile before creating a new record.
Tag source (website / instagram / facebook / youtube / whatsapp).
Respect opt-out: never contact a lead that has opted out.
followup_rules: First follow-up within 24 business hours of lead capture.
Send only WhatsApp Business template-approved messages.
Stop follow-up if the lead opts out or status becomes lost/converted.
